# Current compiler finite-support and nominal-base interaction diagnostic

This package proposes 22 unchanged source programs (10 datatype, 12 arrow) and 44 physical verify invocations: one explicit AdditionalAxioms=false and one explicit AdditionalAxioms=true projection per program. It is source-only preparation; none of these proposed results or counts is claimed as measured here.

Only the current c9 compiler from public run 37347177735, artifact 11361575690, is reused. Its actual original build commit is 31f49205d82e73a8db944ef0b9c2be063736d72c. The requested product is 4e50e86cde6ab2ef6cab0762ffc4df59d646dc15, with identical Source 9c2bb48a778ee2abd6ef10f8a0d72f7843a16af5, Core 1be0fe66bc603a9fc279e522e925be22417a7c41 and Driver 208a4277a53e6dc068f5ed2f36e5824a6097bece trees. Actual version must be 4.11.0+fcb2042d.review.c9c7622d. Fresh public API metadata, original successful build receipts, all 329 compiler file hashes/modes, 208 components and seven bundled libraries are checked. The baseline and e050 compiler arms cannot be selected. No rebuild occurs.

The 12 arrow sources retain their literal RUN headers and bodies. The verify macro is expanded from the pinned original IntegrationTests/LitTests.cs. All macro defaults and literal arguments retain their order; the original later 16M resource limit and one core override the earlier macro defaults. The two explicit AX options and CSV/JSON/BPL observations are derived diagnostic axes, not literal RUN execution. Original intended exit wrappers remain in the source and ledger; no count oracle or golden is invented.

The 10 datatype sources had no literal RUN. Their unchanged bodies and previously reviewed universal/negative intentions are preserved; the explicit diagnostic proposal uses the same 16M resource limit, one core, refreshed/general/extended newtypes and normalizeDeclarationOrder:0. These proposed settings are labelled separately from the literal arrow commands. Every invocation uses the named pinned Z3 5.1.0; no seed option is added. The existing 300-second verify macro limit remains. A 600-second wall limit is an execution safety cap; a timeout is a retained failure. Compiler and solver version probes are recorded separately from the 44 verify calls.

Each raw record retains actual argv, source/hash, stdout, stderr, exit, timeouts, emitted CSV/JSON/BPL presence and hashes, actual summary counts and diagnostic source locations. Intended negative lines are bound to the source; a matching exit or overlapping line does not establish semantic rejection. Independent final-false controls require the preceding inhabited/valid obligations to succeed. Earlier positive errors, warnings and capacity failures remain visible. Universal contracts are the actual arbitrary/generic contracts in each source, including the complete map/stream/capture specifications.

Before and after each pair, actual Source files, complete compiler bytes/modes, package bytes and solver bytes are checked. The report requires all 22 case reports and all 44 raw invocations for observation closure. Missing proofs, rejected CLI options, resolver failures, warnings, OOR and missing BPL are never converted into acceptance. Raw BPL equality would not establish solver-query or proof-cost equality.

The workflow executes only on the exact public repository's scratch branches, uses SDK 8.0.425, and records failed setup/collector steps. Its final exit is diagnostic-only. Action success cannot establish proof green, source adoption, or an accepted negative. No canonical source body, contract or existing oracle is changed by this package.
